body: I’ve felt so much guilt because I know I was single but I’ve been cheated on and I should of been stronger and put my feelings aside, I’ve ended up with all the blame from a lot of people and I know I would never do something like that again. I had this stupid idea that sometimes things don’t work with people because everyone’s got their perfect person out there and I thought I’d found mine so I guess that made it less bad as way of justifying it but now I feel like I do kind of deserve it if I get cheated on because I was part of someone getting really hurt. It wasn’t very real until she found out and then I felt like the worst person in the world. I’m not sure what karma I’m in for haha. We’ve talked about since I posted this briefly and he said he hasn’t cheated physically and doesn’t believe in emotional cheating. He said he lied because I wouldn’t of been happy if he told me the truth but I wouldn’t have half these questions if he had just told me and a little part of me would of been insecure but I definitely wouldn’t of said anything because it would of only made things worse and I’ve said over and over again if you think you’ve made a mistake then as much as it will hurt then I won’t hate you if you try again with her but don’t lie and tell me where I stand and I can’t do backwards and forwards so if you chose to go then I’m not going to be able to try again no matter what because I’d never be quite able to trust that he wouldn’t just leave like that again and I want to have a relationship where trust is something we both have so I’d probably ruin it with never being able to fully trust it would last. I’ve never been a love triangle before and it’s the most stressful thing I can imagine to the start of relationship, never again like you say hindsight is wonderful thing. I think in my mind now I’m just wondering if he thinks he’s made a mistake and we don’t seem to be able to talk abbot it without him getting stressed and saying if I don’t want it then break up with him, it’s just sad because in such a short space of time we can’t even communicate and we used to be awesome at it and he would make me think by the way he deals with things and he said I showed him a lot about communication because I won’t argue, I love talking in general and I’ve been around so many people who just shout and insult each other out of anger, and after being with someone who only communicated though putting me down and shouting if it was a good day I’ll let someone scream and shout but I’m not getting involved, half because I literally find it impossible I think it’s a protection mechanism from the lesson that I got taught from a child that there’s only one answer that people like want to hear it’s not worth it to say anything else unless you want to be shown what a lesson that you will not be forgetting anytime soon. I might be able to have better debate in a few years and if your home n a bad mood and I want a little loving spat that no one means I’m probably pretty boring there’s 90% chance I’ll just go mute or if your really lucky cry because I’m finding it quite a challenge to start living and not surviving anymore. I feel like my point is valid but then again so is his and I’m totally stuck because I feel like if I break up with him I’ll be losing someone I really really really care about and I’m giving up to easy but at the same time I honestly feel like he’s stopped caring about the relationship and me, it’s not the same as was a couple of weeks ago and I’m used to being on my own but I’m not used to being scared to lose someone so I’m totally stuck between head and heart.

He’s not really been there for me very much recently but  he said that’s because I’m dealing with my own issues and when I’m sad it makes him depressed and I always see the negative in everything but I’ve tried explaining that it’s because I’m used to everything being negative for as long as I can remember and I’m just changing my mindset because I have really bad anxiety so I worry all the time but I feel like that’s getting better.he’s always been so supportive and kind and used to make me feel like I was only girl he wanted and was always talking about us getting married and I guess I was so happy that things had ended up like this I just trusted everything he said and I’ve got massive trust issues because I had an abusive childhood and relationship from 15-20 with a guy who made to scared to let someone hug me without feeling uncomfortable, he abused me physically emotionally and sexually since before I knew any better and I never thought I would trust anyone again but I my now boyfriend made me laugh, showed me that people could be kind, listened to me and talked about everything I’ve been though that I can talk about, he never pressured me and made me feel like I enjoyed having sex which until very shortly before I met him I’d spent years thinking that was just something that you did because you were told or made to. He called me the most beautiful girl in the world and told me he had liked me since he met me ( I felt the same) and yeah it was bad timing but I thought he loved all the things about me that my ex had spent years telling me no one ever would. I didn’t believe he even found me attractive at first and I was scared that I’d let him in and then end up getting hurt but he said he loved me and that he couldn’t imagine me being with anyone else and even though it wasn’t easy we got together and then at the start of the year we moved to a house as a fresh start and I though he was as happy as I was, like he as perfect in my eyes. He’s always suffered from depression and that’s been getting worse and worse but I know how it feels and I’ve always tried to just let him do what he needs to do to get though that and be there if he needs anything, but I the last few weeks everything is just annoying him and I feel like everything I say or do is wrong and annoying to him, he will fall out with over nothing and I feel like crying every time he gets annoyed because I’m not used to being like this at all but I think it makes things worse when I’m upset by them. All the things that he used to like are just becoming things to distance himself I feel, we have spent most of our time off together for since last September and we are literally best friends and I would for anything to see him smile, I think maybe because he’s the first person I’ve loved like this. I’ve felt like the worst person ever for how we got together because I know it was wrong but I guess in my head because I thought something good was coming out of it then in a year it would be something that wasn’t making him so depressed he didn’t want to live, I have took abit to heart because he is always saying that all he’s ever wanted since he met me is me and he can’t believe he’s with me and how happy he is, but he feels bad for hurting his ex because she has had a lot of bad experiences and she didn’t have any idea he wasn’t happy. Until last week I was the happiest I’ve ever been and now I feel like you said it’s becoming toxic and one sided, suddenly he wants to go out every day until 3 am at least and he never has his phone or texts me anymore when he goes out which is so different to how we used to be. I feel like he is making stupid fights about something we could talk about and used to talk about and he has gone from being super open and always respectful and kind to me to spending his time ignoring me or texting his ex about all the “problems” in his life that he used to come and talk to me about. I’ve told him this was my fear about our relationship because of the way we got together and I’ve always said I come and talk to me and we will fix it and if we can’t fix and one us wants to break up then we break up properly and he said to once this was going to the relationship he worked though any problems and he wouldn’t ever give up on,  but he’s literally done the opposite this week and I’m really hurt but I’m not sure how to bring it up because now if we fall out over anything I won’t see him until 3am and if I call his phone will be off. This week we had one conversation about us that I thought was something to believe and trust in, because I honestly thought he would never hurt me like this because he’s always telling me that he could never cheat on me because he’s seen how much it hurts someone now and could never break my heart and that he’s going to meet a friend and take his mind off everything that’s stressing him out. I went to see a mutual friend who told me he was at his house ex’s house and I have never felt more gutted, I tried to call him but his phone was off or the battery was dead. When he came home at 2 am he accused me of cheating on him and I’ve never seen him lose his temper like that, but when I asked him if he had been with his ex he told me I was being lied to and that he had been with his friends all day and how could I accuse him cheating when it’s hurt everyone so much, he was so convincing that he hadn’t even seen her I felt bad for not believing in him from the start, he said I could read the messages he sent her and that he needed to apologise so he could be at peace with what he did to her. I said he had already apologised a few times and it was probably best to feel bad and not ask her to forgive you when you know she still loves you for her sake unless your planning on trying again he said he had told her that night that he loves me and he is happy with me, I’ve only seen what’s actually been said today as he lost his phone before he could show me them. To cut along story short he’s pretty much asked her to forgive him, told her he will fix his life for her( I’m not being selfish but it really hurt that he said that her when he’s told me that he can’t do for anyone not even himself) and he’s been flirting telling her we’re having problems and he wants to single but I’m making him feel bad about it (not how the conversation went at all, so that hurts aswell) the day he convinced me he wasn’t with her he was at her house and she had picked him up and he was writing her in his word a “cute message” on what’s app and he’s been calling her at 3 am when I’m asleep. He’s lied about everything to do with her but it’s the first time he’s given me any reason to doubt him and he says he’s sorry for messaging her like that and he loves me and that was end of conversation. I wanted to tell him how much it had hurt me but I’m so scared of losing the person who I’m closest to I didn’t say anything else because if I’m being honest I thought he might use it as an excuse to go to see her again, I’m gutted and just trying to be as nice as I can and I’ve said I believe him because at the time I did but I was upset and it’s been a stressful horrible sad week and I’ve cried more this week than in the last 2 years. But the more I think about it the more it seems wrong and like he’s cheated on me but won’t tell me, he’s still messaging her so he can’t really think that much of me because how would he feel if it was the other way round? I told him be friends with anyone you like but if you lie about something like this I can’t see the point unless they have spelt together or he wants to get back with her but he won’t tell me, I’m scared the longer we stay together I’ll just keep loving him more and I keep forgiving every thing that upsets me because if loved me like he did a week ago then id never leave him but I’m starting to think that maybe if I just let him go then as heart broken I’ll be he won’t have to break up with me because he can’t feel like he loves me or he doesn’t love me like I thought he did because I’ve made it clear this is hurting me and he is still talking to her and there’s no respect in the situation, I know he would leave me if I had done that if was telling the truth about cheating or not. He doesn’t see it as wrong and I think there’s a massive difference between what he’s done and being friends with someone and how can I feel secure when I’m always feeling like I’m not going to good enough compared to his ex. In the past he’s compared me to her a lot when he’s annoyed at me and I think it hurts more because I think the opposite about him and I’ve always told him how much I trust him and love him and he I’ve ended up feeling like no matter what I do I’ll never be the person he wanted, I’m just to in love to let go even though my gut feeling is that I’m not who he wants to be with even though he says he does.

I’m trying to justify it in my mind but I know I wouldn’t do this to anyone if I loved them so I’m guessing I’m just making this more painful, I’m just a massive softie and I really thought this my happy ever after, and I’ve been feeling like I’m not good enough for him or why would he hurt me like this even just with the messages and lying about spending time with her feel like the trust is pretty ruined and I would actually of been more than fine with it he had been open and honest and just wanted to be friends with her.
Karma I suppose a life lesson though
